generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Bidder shall have experience either in Supply of shafts of dia. not less than 90mm to a reputed industry OR in reconditioning of Clinker Grinder assembly. As a proof, Bidder shall submit relevant Job order/Work Order/Purchase order.

The Bidder shall have executed works mentioned in PQR-1 (Experience PQR) worth of Rs.5.22 lakhs in any one year of the preceding five years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) & Bidder shall furnish the relevant invoices for having supplied OR work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer for having completed the reconditioning work

Bidder in their name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.10.43 lakhs and as a proof, the bidder shall furnish turnover certificate and profit & loss account duly certified by the chartered accountant.
